claim: Key per-pixel colour maps by a pixel of the unshifted picture, not by memory address, when the game shifts its graphics in memory.

evidence.text: The game shifts frame k in place (shift 0/2/4/6); resolved nibbles use each key bit's role in the unshifted picture; painted pieces use sprite palette offset 15.
evidence.quote: Resolved nibbles (build time, Python): per key bit its role in the unshifted picture is fixed
